command_templates.name: open_file
command_templates.when: to open a CSV, TSV, XLSX or TXT file for analysis

usage_description: A user-friendly tool to analyze and visualize CSV, TSV, XLSX, and TXT files. Supports multiple file types and provides features like grouping, tagging, and exporting.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: Rows with tags indicating potential issues or interest.
suspicious_indicators.description: Rows that have been tagged by the user may indicate areas of interest for further investigation.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: Large groupings in columns, possibly indicating significant data points.
suspicious_indicators.description: Grouping large numbers of rows can help identify patterns or anomalies within the dataset.

known_false_positives: Tagging and grouping are common analysis techniques that may not always indicate malicious activity.
